upstream_frontmatter.name: paper-polishing-v1
upstream_frontmatter.description: Use this skill when the user wants to polish, rewrite, translate, restructure, diagnose, or final-check academic manuscripts for English journal submission, especially when converting Chinese-style academic writing into English journal-style argumentation. This includes SCI/SSCI paper polishing, abstract improvement, introduction/literature review/method/results/discussion/conclusion rewriting, reviewer-style diagnosis, terminology consistency checks, Chinese-to-English academic rewriting, policy implications refinement, and AI-trace cleanup. Do not use it to fabricate data, citations, experiments, findings, or unsupported claims.
